    The contragredient action on a vector-space dual #

    This is the concrete algebraic core used to instantiate AlignedBiduality with D = Hom_k(-, k).

    source
    def LargeIndecomposable.Contragredient.dualActionHom (K : Type uK) (R : Type uR) (X : Type uX) [Field K] [Ring R] [Algebra K R] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [Module R X] [IsScalarTower K R X] :
    Rᵐᵒᵖ →+* Module.End K (Module.Dual K X)

    The action of Rᵐᵒᵖ on the K-linear dual, encoded as a ring homomorphism into the K-linear endomorphism ring.
